statement: Chronofy already combines learnable exponential temporal decay with explicit temporal-validity checking: it embeds temporal validity into the representation, retrieval and reasoning layers, reserves a temporal subspace in Matryoshka embeddings, integrates learnable exponential decay into graph-based retrieval, and applies Signal Temporal Logic robustness to evaluate the temporal validity of retrieved knowledge.

evidence.quote: Layer 2 integrates learnable exponential decay functions into graph-based retrieval
embeds temporal validity directly into the representation, retrieval, and reasoning layers of RAG systems
reserves a dedicated temporal subspace within Matryoshka embeddings to make fact age structurally irremovable from the representation
